title: markdown-indexer asset index
description: The asset index: every hashed non-markdown file keyed by its relative path. Produced when Options.HashAssets is set, and printed by the CLI -assets flag.

asset.title: markdown-indexer asset
asset.description: One non-markdown file as indexed. Its content identity is the sha256 of its bytes, not its path.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the vault root, always with forward slashes.

modifiedUnix.description: Last modified, as a unix timestamp in seconds.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the file's bytes. Identical files share a hash. It is not an IPLD CID.
